acceptance: Every shipped `*_tuned.yaml` (packaged or examples) has a registry entry; absent measurements resolve to `unmeasured`.
CLI tests show the warning for an unmeasured template and no warning for an exact matching measured state.
Result JSON carries the selected state under `platform.tuning.template_evidence`, and the Explorer shows it in `RunReceipt`.
The requested-config hash is unchanged for every existing shipped template when evidence state changes.
Scale, memory-basis/value, or engine-version mismatches never reuse another tier's measured state.

description:
## Problem
Every shipped `*_tuned.yaml` looks equally trustworthy. Nothing tells a user that the Databricks, Snowflake and DuckDB templates have never been measured against `notuning`, or that the ClickHouse decisions hold only at SF1.

## Change
Implement owner decision D3 (label, do not quarantine; recorded in `tuning-evidence-tuned-mode-promise-20261008`):
- Add one registry file, `benchbox/core/tuning/profiles/template_evidence.yaml`, keyed platform → benchmark. Each entry has a `measurements` list; each row records `state`, `scale_factor`, `memory`, `engine_version`, `measured_on` and `evidence`. Empty lists mean `unmeasured`. Multiple rows let one template have distinct scale/memory/engine outcomes.
- A memory scope is `{basis, value}`: `container_limit` uses the exact captured container limit; `host_total_gb` uses captured physical host memory only for local/dataframe process runs. Missing, invalid or ambiguous scope never matches.
- Initially every template has an empty measurements list. Item 25's retroactive pass adds real, scoped states only after its outcome procedure.
- The result records the state under `platform.tuning.template_evidence` only for an exact scale, memory scope and engine-version match; absent/mismatched scope remains `unmeasured`.
- On a tuned run whose state is `unmeasured`, the console prints one line: "Tuned template <platform>/<benchmark> has no measured benefit: the result shows the template was applied, not that it is faster than notuning."
- The results Explorer shows the state as a row in `RunReceipt` ("Template evidence").

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Runs are never blocked because of the state; there is no hard gate.
- The state is metadata. It never enters `requested_config_hash`, and hashes of existing templates stay unchanged.
- A shipped template must not be left at `measured-regression`.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`. Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop 5ca12e6ca.
